question: What is the actual moment of abandoning the body?
premises: The experiences described above occur while still in the body.
These experiences are not themselves the abandonment of the body.
The true abandonment is a single final moment of breathing.
inference: Death-experiences occur in the body, but the real abandonment of the body is only the final breath-moment.
plain_english: Experiences like these occur in the body and are not the same as abandoning the body; the real abandonment is only that single final moment consisting of the last breath.
